title: M/S Hariom Industries Limited v. Dakshinanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd. & Another
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
disposition: Writ dismissed; interim vacated following Dev Prayag on clause 4.20
headnote: A writ challenging demand of additional security under clause 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 is dismissed, the controversy having been decided against the consumer in Dev Prayag Paper Mill; any interim restraint is vacated.
facts: The petitioner, M/s Hariom Industries Limited, challenged a notice dated 3 April 2014 by Dakshinanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd. demanding additional security under paragraph 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. On 21 April 2014 the High Court, noting a similar stay in Supreme Ceramics Limited, restrained the licensee from demanding additional security until further orders. At the final hearing both sides accepted that the same controversy had been decided against the consumer in Dev Prayag Paper Mill on 21 March 2017.

holding_units.holding: The writ challenging a demand of additional security under clause 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 is dismissed. Counsel agreed that the controversy stood decided against the consumer in Dev Prayag Paper Mill, where a challenge to clause 4.20 was found to have no merit. The earlier interim restraint on demanding additional security is vacated.
